representation.shell_command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import dendropy
import sys

tree = dendropy.Tree.get(path="${tree_file}", schema="newick", preserve_underscores=True)
taxon_namespace = tree.taxon_namespace
taxa = list(taxon_namespace)

pdm = dendropy.calculate.treecalculate.PhylogeneticDistanceMatrix.from_tree(tree)

with open("patristic_distances.tsv", "w") as f:
    f.write("taxon1\ttaxon2\tpatristic_distance\n")
    for i, t1 in enumerate(taxa):
        for t2 in taxa[i+1:]:
            dist = pdm.patristic_distance(t1, t2)
            f.write(f"{t1.label}\t{t2.label}\t{dist}\n")
PYEOF
